question: Why are you not speaker when I utter sound?
premises: When I utter sound, are you not speaker?
Even in prakṛti this fault remains.
inference: Attributing speech to another speaker is faulty.
uncertainties: kartryāṃ may mean in the doer.
plain_english: When I utter sound, why are you not speaker? Even in prakṛti this fault remains: doership is devoid of doership.
